Ilan Goldfajn (@igoldfajn)

Happy to be back in Boston—or rather, Cambridge, MA. A special place for me. I lived here for five years more than three decades ago, and I’ve kept coming back ever since.

This time I'm here for a series of well-organized events led by active, smart and motivated students, with a very high level of attendance from speakers and the public. 

Congrats to the VII Brazil Legal Symposium and the Brasil Project organizers!
